messages:
Ethan (sales): Heads-up — starting Nebula deal POC. They want a short-latency chat and embeddings for search. Can we validate model catalog fit + any infra blockers?
Priya (SE): Got it. Customer wants ~200 req/s peak, mostly short contexts (<512 tokens). Asking for: baseline accuracy for their intent model, cheapest quant variant with KV cache support, and KMS in VPC.
Liam (infra): KV cache + VPC KMS doable on Dedicated, need to confirm GPU type. For 200 rps with latency <120ms we recommend A10G or equivalent with batching config.
Ethan (sales): Are there prebuilt variants that support prefix-KV caching? Their engineering team cares about conversational history reuse.
Priya (SE): Most Llama-family weights we have support KV. Quantized variants sometimes lose KV speed if not compiled for int8 kernels. Quick check config I'm proposing:
```
model: nebula-llama-34b
variant: q4_kv
kv_cache: enabled
max_seq: 512
batching: latency-optimized
```
Priya (SE): If q4_kv isn't verified, fallback to fp16_kv and we can bench. Also need to run a compatibility sniff for tokenization differences (they use sentencepiece).
Jordana (security): Security checklist: confirm KMS integration (customer-managed keys), VPC peering requirements, and export controls. Also need questionnaire items answered: data retention, audit logs, and where inference traces live.
Ethan (sales): Pricing ask from procurement — rough committed monthly cost for Dedicated pool supporting above. Can infra give a ballpark?
Liam (infra): Ballpark committed tier: ~$12k/mo for reserved A10G cluster sized for 200 rps with headroom (incl infra + runtime). If they opt for mixed quant variants and autoscaling bursts, add ~20%. Precise quote after final model benchmark.
Ethan (sales): Noted. Priya — can you run a quick catalog probe with a 1k sample of their prompts and share perf + quality numbers? Need both token cost and latency percentiles.
Priya (SE): Will do. I'm going to run two runs: q4_kv (if passes) and fp16_kv. Expect initial results by EOD. Will post logs here and tag infra for deploy.
infra-bot: Deployment ticket created: #DEP-4589 — dedicated-poc/nebula. Assigned to Liam.
Liam (infra): Thanks infra-bot. I'll verify KMS tooling and create a minimal VPC config template for the customer. Any legal PII constraints?
Jordana (security): They flagged regulated health data in the questionnaire. We'll need DLP guidance and ensure logs are redacted; mark Private deployment if they require full control.
Ethan (sales): Ok — leaning Dedicated with optional Private later. Priya, coordinate with customer to send the 1k prompt set to our secure upload (S3 pre-signed link).
Priya (SE): On it. Upload link shortly, will run bench and post here with a short table: model, variant, p50/p95 latency, tok/sec, quality score. :rocket:
Ethan (sales): Perfect. Thanks team — let's aim to have a preflight report and pricing slide by tomorrow morning for the demo.
